name: Sparrow Costa-Tagaq
description:
Sparrow works the gaps between corponation jurisdictions. She does not run contracts of her own; she runs the supply chains that the contracts of others depend on. If you need a specific obsolete chip, a Pulse-corridor unauthorized routing slot, a Tier 5 access card whose Tier 5 registration has lapsed within the last seventy-two hours, a translator who speaks a language the corponation databases do not register as currently in use, an unaugmented body of the correct height and weight for a False Death Protocol delivery — Sparrow is the operator you call. The thing arrives. You pay. You do not ask where it came from. The not-asking is the price of the discount that Sparrow's network is built on.

The network is large. Larger than Sparrow lets on. It includes operators in every Pulse corridor in the western hemisphere, three confirmed contacts inside corponation logistics divisions, and at least one contact inside the GLMZ orbital salvage cooperative who is in regular contact with someone who has been receiving signal from objects that have fallen from the space elevator's southern lane in the past six months. Sparrow has not advertised this last contact. Kyle suspects it. Sparrow has not denied the suspicion. Neither of them has named it.
heritage: Portuguese-Inuit. Father's family from Porto via the Iberian climate corridor. Mother's family from Iqaluit via the polar zone resettlement programs (same general migration as Bear, but no connection). Speaks Portuguese, Inuktitut, English, a working dialect of Spanish she uses with her southern contacts.
specialty: sourcing; routing; the kind of asset acquisition that requires four phone calls and three personal visits and a favor or two before the asset can be confirmed to exist
method: never moves the asset herself. The asset is moved by one of the operators in her network. Sparrow's role is the routing — knowing which operator can move which asset through which corridor at which time of which day for which fee. The route is the product. The asset is incidental.
code: she does not source for child-harvester operations or slaver operations. She has refused at least three contracts on these grounds publicly and probably more privately. Within those limits she sources for anyone whose Φ is good and whose request is one she can route cleanly. The cleanliness, by her definition, includes not leaving her network exposed.
signature_gear: a comm rig she built herself from components Echo helped her source; a notebook in a code only Sparrow can read (Sumi has tried; Sumi has reported back that the code is good); a fold-up bicycle she rides around the GLMZ inner corridor because the inner corridor is the part of her network where she does her own personal contacts; a set of identity-document forgeries that let her cross any tier checkpoint as the kind of nobody nobody stops
relationship_to_kyle: professional, friendly-distant. Sparrow has sourced for Kyle at least eight times over four years. The relationship is transactional and clean. Kyle pays Sparrow standard rates plus a small premium for the speed Sparrow provides. Sparrow charges Kyle slightly less than her standard premium because Kyle is one of the operators in her network whose absence would, in her view, materially damage the network's quality. Neither of them has named the discount. It is filed under *good business*.
aesthetic: late thirties, lean from the bicycle, hair short and practical, dresses in layers because the GLMZ corridor between tiers has variable temperature and Sparrow rides through all of them. Carries a small messenger bag at all times. The bag is part of how the network knows her.
spin_off_hook: A piece of orbital wreckage that landed in the southern Pulse corridor six weeks ago turns out to be from a source the corponation salvage cooperative cannot identify. Sparrow's contact in the cooperative routes the wreckage to her for resale. The wreckage is sealed and intact and is, by every test Sparrow can run, not entirely terrestrial in origin. She has eighteen hours to decide whether to sell it to the highest bidder, sit on it until she can figure out what it is, or destroy it. Kyle is her short-list backup for any of the three options. He gets the call.
